+import Foundation
+
+public struct CostInput: Equatable, Sendable {
+    public let distanceMeters: Double
+    public let consumptionPer100: Decimal
+    public let realWorldFactor: Decimal
+    public let unitPriceMilliEUR: UnitPriceMilliEUR
+    public let manualExpenses: [MoneyCents]
+
+    public init(distanceMeters: Double, consumptionPer100: Decimal, realWorldFactor: Decimal = 1, unitPriceMilliEUR: UnitPriceMilliEUR, manualExpenses: [MoneyCents] = []) {
+        precondition(distanceMeters >= 0 && consumptionPer100 > 0 && realWorldFactor > 0)
+        self.distanceMeters = distanceMeters; self.consumptionPer100 = consumptionPer100
+        self.realWorldFactor = realWorldFactor; self.unitPriceMilliEUR = unitPriceMilliEUR
+        self.manualExpenses = manualExpenses
+    }
+}
+
+public struct CostResult: Equatable, Sendable {
+    public let energyUnits: Decimal
+    public let energyCostEUR: Decimal
+    public let energyCostCents: MoneyCents
+    public let totalCents: MoneyCents
+}
+
+public enum CostEngine {
+    public static func calculate(_ input: CostInput) -> CostResult {
+        makeResult(energyUnits: energy(for: input.distanceMeters, consumption: input.consumptionPer100, factor: input.realWorldFactor), input: input)
+    }
+
+    public static func calculate(segmentDistancesMeters: [Double], consumptionPer100: Decimal, realWorldFactor: Decimal = 1, unitPriceMilliEUR: UnitPriceMilliEUR, manualExpenses: [MoneyCents] = []) -> CostResult {
+        precondition(segmentDistancesMeters.allSatisfy { $0 >= 0 } && consumptionPer100 > 0 && realWorldFactor > 0)
+        let energyUnits = segmentDistancesMeters.reduce(Decimal.zero) { partial, segment in
+            partial + energy(for: segment, consumption: consumptionPer100, factor: realWorldFactor)
+        }
+        let input = CostInput(distanceMeters: segmentDistancesMeters.reduce(0, +), consumptionPer100: consumptionPer100, realWorldFactor: realWorldFactor, unitPriceMilliEUR: unitPriceMilliEUR, manualExpenses: manualExpenses)
+        return makeResult(energyUnits: energyUnits, input: input)
+    }
+
+    private static func energy(for distanceMeters: Double, consumption: Decimal, factor: Decimal) -> Decimal {
+        let distance = Decimal(string: String(distanceMeters), locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX"))!
+        return distance / 100000 * consumption * factor
+    }
+
+    private static func makeResult(energyUnits: Decimal, input: CostInput) -> CostResult {
+        let energyCostEUR = energyUnits * Decimal(input.unitPriceMilliEUR.value) / 1000
+        let centsValue = roundHalfUp(energyCostEUR * 100)
+        let extras = input.manualExpenses.reduce(Int64(0)) { $0 + $1.value }
+        return CostResult(energyUnits: energyUnits, energyCostEUR: energyCostEUR,
+                          energyCostCents: MoneyCents(centsValue), totalCents: MoneyCents(centsValue + extras))
+    }
+
+    private static func roundHalfUp(_ value: Decimal) -> Int64 {
+        var rounded = Decimal.zero
+        NSDecimalRound(&rounded, &value, 0, .plain)
+        return NSDecimalNumber(decimal: rounded).int64Value
+    }
+}

+import Foundation

+}

+    public init(_ value: Int64) {

+        self.value = value
+    }
+}
+
+public enum MoneyParsingError: Error, Equatable { case invalid, ambiguous, outOfRange }
+
+public extension MoneyCents {
+    static func parse(_ text: String, locale: Locale = Locale(identifier: "es_ES")) throws -> MoneyCents {
+        let separator = locale.decimalSeparator ?? ","
+        guard !text.isEmpty, text.filter({ $0 == "." || $0 == "," }).allSatisfy({ String($0) == separator }) else {
+            throw text.contains(",") && text.contains(".") ? MoneyParsingError.ambiguous : MoneyParsingError.invalid
+        }
+        let normalized = text.replacingOccurrences(of: separator, with: ".")
+        guard let decimal = Decimal(string: normalized, locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX")) else { throw MoneyParsingError.invalid }
+        var cents = decimal * 100
+        var rounded = Decimal.zero
+        NSDecimalRound(&rounded, &cents, 0, .plain)
+        return MoneyCents(NSDecimalNumber(decimal: rounded).int64Value)
+    }
+}
+
+public extension UnitPriceMilliEUR {
+    static func parse(_ text: String, locale: Locale = Locale(identifier: "es_ES")) throws -> UnitPriceMilliEUR {
+        let separator = locale.decimalSeparator ?? ","
+        guard !text.isEmpty, text.filter({ $0 == "." || $0 == "," }).allSatisfy({ String($0) == separator }) else {
+            throw text.contains(",") && text.contains(".") ? MoneyParsingError.ambiguous : MoneyParsingError.invalid
+        }
+        let normalized = text.replacingOccurrences(of: separator, with: ".")
+        guard let decimal = Decimal(string: normalized, locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US_POSIX")), decimal > 0 else { throw MoneyParsingError.invalid }
+        var milli = decimal * 1000
+        var rounded = Decimal.zero
+        NSDecimalRound(&rounded, &milli, 0, .plain)
+        return UnitPriceMilliEUR(NSDecimalNumber(decimal: rounded).int64Value)
+    }
+}

+import Foundation
+
+public enum SplitRule: Equatable, Sendable { case everyone, passengersOnly }
+
+public struct SplitResult: Equatable, Sendable {
+    /// Final amounts, in participant order; index zero is always the driver.
+    public let shares: [MoneyCents]
+    public init(shares: [MoneyCents]) { self.shares = shares }
+}
+
+public enum SplitEngine {
+    public static func split(total: MoneyCents, people: Int, rule: SplitRule) -> SplitResult {
+        precondition(people >= 1 && people <= 8)
+        let totalValue = total.value
+        guard totalValue > 0 else { return SplitResult(shares: Array(repeating: .zero, count: people)) }
+        switch rule {
+        case .everyone:
+            let q = totalValue / Int64(people), remainder = totalValue % Int64(people)
+            return SplitResult(shares: [MoneyCents(q + remainder)] + Array(repeating: MoneyCents(q), count: people - 1))
+        case .passengersOnly:
+            precondition(people > 1, "passengersOnly requiere al menos un pasajero")
+            let count = people - 1, q = totalValue / Int64(count), remainder = Int(totalValue % Int64(count))
+            return SplitResult(shares: [MoneyCents.zero] + (0..<count).map { MoneyCents(q + ($0 < remainder ? 1 : 0)) })
+        }
+    }
+}
